question: On banking-redshift, calculate bank-wide revenue over all available history using the published reporting marts: sum fee_revenue from banking-redshift.dev.marts_finance.fct_fee_revenue for ATM Fee, Wire Fee, and Account Fee, and sum total_commission from banking-redshift.dev.marts_wealth.fct_trades for trade commissions.
